items.name: json-inspector
items.title: JSON Inspector
items.description: An interactive JSON and JavaScript object inspector for shadcn/ui with search, expandable nodes, copy actions, circular reference protection, and support for common JavaScript types.

items.name: json-diff
items.title: JSON Diff
items.description: An expandable JSON and JavaScript diff viewer for shadcn/ui that highlights added, removed, modified, and unchanged values.
